pages.text: A 3 x 3 x 3 multiblock that runs on lava. It smelts Illyrium Ore with slag into Dirty Illyrium Ingots, and alloys Pure Illyrium Dust with Tetrium Dust into Illyrium Nuggets.$(br2)The lower Lava Pylons (orange sockets) take lava by pipe. The upper ones (yellow sockets) take RF once an RF Upgrade is fitted.$(br2)Stuck on a build? Empty your hand and $(l)sneak + right-click$() the controller for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

pages.title: Illyrium Crucible
pages.text: Controller at the bottom front centre. 12 Casing, 8 Lava Pylons, 2 Item Hatches, 1 Core.
